games.title: Sludge
games.description:
Survival island and cave exploration game with resource gathering, crafting, grid base building, and night raids.
### Update 1.3

- Island & Water: Bigger island, shore fishing, drowning if too far/deep.
- Loot & Nights: Lootable structures and night types (dark, medium, brighter).
- Defense: Turrets/bots vs raiders - breakable by accident or raiders, can be picked up and moved.
- Start & Tools: Hand instead of starter stone; no free flashlight, added cheap craftable torch and craftable flashlights with varying durability; stone needs a pickaxe; tool durability.
- Inventory: Added keybinds and item usage info.
- Sandbox Mode: Unlocks after 3 total nights survived - progress saves across sessions and restarts.
- Fall Damage: Added fall damage.

### Fixes

- Mobile Controls: Reliable quick taps, fixed steady-stick stop, sprint on higher stick push.
- Bug Fixes: Fixed mid-air craft freeze, raiders no longer hit unreachable walls above, lower vertical aggro range.
- Version: 1.3 and 1.3-mobile on mobile.
